text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix of dreams. Carrying their 
own dreams and trials in their hearts, the 
Umamusume sprinted ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both Mejiro Palmer—and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I'm at my limit~! My 
legs and my heart... are totally maxed 
out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's tough, but the Twinkle Series really 
is the best! Even if I'm still far from 
running freely, though.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for keeping you all waiting. Did 
you see... how I ran today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now. And starting from here, once 
again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Um, Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to ask! Bearing 
this much pressure, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you get stiff or scared at all? You 
didn't really seem to be feeling the 
pressure either.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Pressure? Yeah, I guess... I always feel 
the expectations. But...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know about getting stiff... 
I don't have the luxury to get that way to 
begin with.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I have no choice but to answer their 
expectations, and what's more, I always 
want to."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Living up to the hopes of those who place 
their dreams in me— that is the only 
reason I race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Living up to... their dreams...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I see... There really are Umamusume who 
can take that crazy amount of pressure and 
convert it entirely into power.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap... So this is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So running freely is what it means...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone had gained valuable lessons. Yet, 
remaining challenges still lingered—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm just not hitting my ideal speed. 
I've got to find a way to fully unleash my 
body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A run like this isn't enough to go down in 
history. I need to train both my mind and 
my legs much more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I see, we're the same... Though our 
levels might be different...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is carrying something. Even so, 
reaching out with all their might—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Good work. How did it go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just as I thought. I still have a 
long way to go! I still can't bring myself 
to be confident, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, I understand now. There's not a 
single girl in the Twinkle Series who 
isn't carrying something on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the only one struggling. That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'll gain even more strength to 
overcome this pressure! Just like Oguri 
Cap.
